lines.en: Robert, I wanted to raise something about the client report that's due on Friday.
lines.zh: 罗伯特，我想说一下周五要交的那份客户报告。

lines.en: Go ahead. Is there a problem?
lines.zh: 说吧。有问题吗？

lines.en: The sales figures from the Asia team still haven't come in, and without them the analysis would be incomplete.
lines.zh: 亚洲团队的销售数据还没到，没有这些数据，分析就不完整。

lines.en: I see. When are they expected?
lines.zh: 明白了。预计什么时候能到？

lines.en: They've promised them by Wednesday evening, but realistically I'd need until Monday to do a proper job.
lines.zh: 他们承诺周三晚上前给，但说实话，我需要到周一才能做好。

lines.en: The trouble is that the client has a board meeting on Monday morning.
lines.zh: 麻烦的是客户周一上午要开董事会。

lines.en: What if I send them a draft on Friday covering everything except Asia, and the full version first thing Monday?
lines.zh: 要不这样：我周五先发一份除亚洲外的草稿，周一一早再发完整版？

lines.en: That could work, as long as we're upfront with them about why.
lines.zh: 这可行，只要我们坦白告诉他们原因。

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll draft an email explaining the situation and copy you in.
lines.zh: 当然。我会写封邮件说明情况，并抄送给你。

lines.en: Great. And next time, flag it a bit earlier if you can see a delay coming.
lines.zh: 很好。下次如果预见到会延误，尽量早点提出来。

lines.en: Fair point. I'll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: 有道理。我会记住的。

dialogues.title: Should we buy an electric car?

lines.en: I've been thinking — our car is getting old. Maybe it's time we went electric.
lines.zh: 我一直在想——我们的车越来越旧了。也许是时候换电动车了。

lines.en: I'm not against it in principle, but they're still pretty expensive, aren't they?
lines.zh: 原则上我不反对，但它们还是挺贵的，不是吗？

lines.en: The upfront cost is higher, but charging at home costs a fraction of what we spend on petrol.
lines.zh: 前期成本是高一些，但在家充电的费用只是我们油费的一小部分。

lines.en: What about long journeys, though? I'd hate to get stuck looking for a charger on the way to your parents'.
lines.zh: 那长途呢？我可不想在去你父母家的路上到处找充电桩。

lines.en: Most new models can do at least four hundred kilometres on a full charge, and there are fast chargers at the services.
lines.zh: 大多数新款充满电至少能跑四百公里，服务区也有快充桩。

lines.en: Fair enough. Have you looked into whether we'd need a charger installed at home?
lines.zh: 说得也是。你查过家里是否需要安装充电桩吗？

lines.en: Yes, it'd cost around eight hundred euros, but there's a government grant that covers part of it.
lines.zh: 查过，大约要八百欧元，但有政府补贴可以覆盖一部分。

lines.en: OK, you've convinced me to at least take one for a test drive.
lines.zh: 好吧，你至少说服我去试驾一辆了。

lines.en: That's all I'm asking. Let's book one for Saturday.
lines.zh: 我就是这个意思。周六预约一辆吧。

dialogues.title: Reporting a problem to a landlord

lines.en: Hi Mr. Harris, it's Sophie from flat 3. I'm afraid there's a leak in the bathroom ceiling.
lines.zh: 哈里斯先生您好，我是3号公寓的索菲。浴室天花板好像漏水了。

lines.en: Oh dear. How bad is it?
lines.zh: 哎呀。严重吗？

lines.en: It started as a few drops, but this morning there was a puddle on the floor and the paint is starting to peel.
lines.zh: 一开始只是几滴，但今早地上已经有一滩水了，油漆也开始脱落。

lines.en: It's probably coming from the flat upstairs. I'll get in touch with them straight away.
lines.zh: 可能是楼上那户漏下来的。我马上联系他们。

lines.en: Thanks. Could you also send a plumber? I'm worried it might damage the electrics.
lines.zh: 谢谢。您能再派个水管工来吗？我担心会损坏电路。

lines.en: Good thinking. In the meantime, don't use the bathroom light, just to be safe.
lines.zh: 考虑得周到。在此期间为了安全，先别开浴室的灯。

lines.en: Will do. When do you think someone could come round?
lines.zh: 好的。您觉得什么时候能有人过来？

lines.en: I'll try to get someone there by tomorrow morning. I'll text you once it's arranged.
lines.zh: 我尽量明早前安排人过去。安排好了我给你发短信。

lines.en: I appreciate it. I'll take some photos in case you need them for the insurance.
lines.zh: 非常感谢。我会拍些照片，以防您办保险时需要。

dialogues.title: Discussing a film
dialogues.scene: 两个朋友看完电影后争论

lines.en: So, what did you make of it? I thought it was brilliant.
lines.zh: 那么，你觉得怎么样？我觉得太精彩了。

lines.en: Honestly, I found it a bit disappointing. The trailer made it look far more exciting.
lines.zh: 说实话，我觉得有点失望。预告片让它看起来刺激多了。

lines.en: Really? I loved how slowly the story built up.
lines.zh: 真的吗？我很喜欢故事慢慢铺陈的方式。

lines.en: Slowly is one word for it. I nearly fell asleep in the middle.
lines.zh: “慢”还算客气了。中间我差点睡着。

lines.en: Fair enough, but you have to admit the acting was outstanding.
lines.zh: 好吧，但你得承认演技非常出色。

lines.en: Oh, definitely. The lead actress deserves an award. It's the script I had issues with.
lines.zh: 那确实。女主角值得拿奖。我有意见的是剧本。

lines.en: What about the ending? I didn't see that twist coming at all.
lines.zh: 那结局呢？那个反转我完全没想到。

lines.en: That's the thing — it felt too convenient, as if the writers didn't know how to finish it.
lines.zh: 问题就在这——它太牵强了，好像编剧不知道怎么收尾。

lines.en: Well, I guess we'll have to agree to disagree.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来我们只能求同存异了。

dialogues.title: A university open day
dialogues.scene: 学生向招生老师咨询课程

lines.en: Hi, I'm interested in the environmental science degree. Could you tell me how the course is structured?
lines.zh: 您好，我对环境科学专业感兴趣。能介绍一下课程是怎么安排的吗？

lines.en: Of course. The first year covers the basics — biology, chemistry and statistics.
lines.zh: 当然。第一年学基础课——生物、化学和统计。

lines.en: In the second year you choose a specialism, such as climate, water or conservation.
lines.zh: 第二年你要选一个专业方向，比如气候、水资源或生态保护。

lines.en: Is there any chance to get practical experience?
lines.zh: 有机会获得实践经验吗？

lines.en: Yes, there's a field trip every year, and in the third year you can do a placement with a company or a charity.
lines.zh: 有，每年都有一次野外考察，第三年可以去企业或公益组织实习。

lines.en: That sounds great. How is the course assessed — mainly exams?
lines.zh: 听起来很棒。课程怎么考核——主要是考试吗？

lines.en: It's roughly half exams and half coursework, including a final-year research project.
lines.zh: 大约一半是考试，一半是平时作业，包括最后一年的研究项目。

lines.en: And what do graduates usually go on to do?
lines.zh: 毕业生通常从事什么工作？

lines.en: Many work in environmental consulting or government, and about a quarter go on to further study.
lines.zh: 很多人在环境咨询公司或政府部门工作，大约四分之一继续深造。

sentences.en: Over the past few years, a growing number of companies have experimented with a four-day working week.
sentences.zh: 过去几年，越来越多的公司尝试了每周四天工作制。

sentences.en: In most trials, employees kept their full salary while working around 32 hours instead of 40.
sentences.zh: 在大多数试点中，员工工作约32小时而不是40小时，工资照拿。

sentences.en: Supporters argue that well-rested workers are more focused, so productivity doesn't fall.
sentences.zh: 支持者认为，休息充足的员工更专注，所以生产率不会下降。

sentences.en: Several studies reported lower stress levels and fewer sick days.
sentences.zh: 几项研究报告称，压力水平降低，病假天数减少。

sentences.en: However, critics point out that the model is much harder to apply in hospitals, schools or shops, where someone has to be present.
sentences.zh: 然而批评者指出，这种模式在医院、学校或商店很难实施，因为那里必须有人在岗。

sentences.en: There is also concern that some employees simply squeeze five days of work into four, which could increase pressure.
sentences.zh: 也有人担心，一些员工只是把五天的工作挤进四天，可能反而增加压力。

questions.q: What usually happened to salaries in the trials?
Why is the model difficult in hospitals?
questions.qZh: 为什么这种模式在医院很难实施？

sentences.en: Most people think procrastination is a problem of time management, but psychologists increasingly see it as a problem of emotion.
sentences.zh: 多数人认为拖延是时间管理的问题，但心理学家越来越把它看作情绪问题。

sentences.en: We tend to put off tasks that make us feel anxious, bored or insecure.
sentences.zh: 我们往往会推迟那些让我们感到焦虑、无聊或不自信的任务。

sentences.en: Avoiding the task gives us short-term relief, which is exactly why the habit is so hard to break.
sentences.zh: 逃避任务能带来短暂的解脱，这正是这个习惯很难改掉的原因。

sentences.en: One useful technique is to commit to working on something for just five minutes.
sentences.zh: 一个有用的方法是承诺只做五分钟。

sentences.en: Once you've started, the task usually feels less threatening, and many people keep going.
sentences.zh: 一旦开始，任务通常就没那么可怕了，很多人会继续做下去。

sentences.en: Being kind to yourself also helps: research suggests that people who forgive themselves for procrastinating do it less next time.
sentences.zh: 善待自己也有帮助：研究表明，原谅自己拖延的人下次拖延会更少。

questions.q: How do psychologists increasingly see procrastination?
questions.qZh: 心理学家越来越如何看待拖延？

questions.q: What does the five-minute technique involve?
options: Starting with just five minutes of work

questions.q: What happens to people who forgive themselves?

sentences.en: In cities around the world, empty rooftops and car parks are being turned into vegetable gardens.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地的城市里，空置的屋顶和停车场正被改造成菜园。

sentences.en: These projects are rarely big enough to feed a whole neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 这些项目很少大到能养活整个街区。

sentences.en: Their real value, organisers say, lies elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 组织者说，它们真正的价值在别处。

sentences.en: They bring together neighbours who would otherwise never meet, and they teach children where food actually comes from.
sentences.zh: 它们让原本素不相识的邻居聚在一起，并让孩子们了解食物究竟从哪里来。

sentences.en: Green roofs also absorb rainwater and help keep buildings cooler in summer.
sentences.zh: 绿色屋顶还能吸收雨水，夏天帮助建筑物降温。

sentences.en: The main challenge is funding, as most gardens rely on volunteers and small grants.
sentences.zh: 主要挑战是资金，因为大多数菜园依靠志愿者和小额资助。

questions.q: According to organisers, what is NOT the main value of these gardens?
questions.qZh: 据组织者说，下列哪项不是这些菜园的主要价值？

sentences.en: People have been eating bread with fillings for thousands of years, but the name 'sandwich' is surprisingly recent.
sentences.zh: 人们吃夹馅面包已有几千年历史，但“三明治”这个名字却出奇地新。

sentences.en: It comes from John Montagu, the fourth Earl of Sandwich, an English aristocrat in the eighteenth century.
sentences.zh: 它来自十八世纪的英国贵族——第四代三明治伯爵约翰·蒙塔古。

sentences.en: According to a popular story, he asked for meat between two slices of bread so he could eat without leaving the card table.
sentences.zh: 据一个流行的说法，他要求把肉夹在两片面包之间，这样就不用离开牌桌也能吃饭。

sentences.en: Historians aren't sure this is true; he may simply have been eating at his desk while working.
sentences.zh: 历史学家不确定这是否属实；他可能只是在办公桌前边工作边吃。

sentences.en: Either way, the idea spread quickly, and by the end of the century the word appeared in English cookbooks.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这个做法迅速流行，到本世纪末这个词已出现在英国食谱中。

questions.q: Who is the sandwich named after?
questions.qZh: 三明治以谁的名字命名？

questions.q: What do historians say about the card-table story?
questions.qZh: 历史学家怎么看牌桌的故事？
options: It is about a different person

news.title: Honeybees are outcompeting wild pollinators, study finds
news.titleZh: 研究发现：蜜蜂正在挤压野生传粉昆虫的生存空间

sentences.en: A two-year study near Cambridge has found that honeybees regularly force other pollinators off flowers.
sentences.zh: 剑桥附近一项为期两年的研究发现，蜜蜂经常把其他传粉昆虫从花上赶走。

sentences.en: Researchers from Anglia Ruskin University spent 93 hours recording encounters between insects on bramble and ivy.
sentences.zh: 安格利亚鲁斯金大学的研究人员花了93小时，记录黑莓和常春藤上昆虫之间的相遇。

sentences.en: Honeybees won most of these contests and started the majority of aggressive interactions, often by chasing rivals away.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂赢得了大多数较量，并发起了多数攻击性互动，常常是把对手赶走。

sentences.en: Other insects avoided honeybees in 28 percent of interactions on bramble and 36 percent on ivy.
sentences.zh: 在黑莓上28%、在常春藤上36%的互动中，其他昆虫选择避开蜜蜂。

sentences.en: On bramble, a doubling of honeybee numbers was linked to a 14 percent fall in bumblebees.
sentences.zh: 在黑莓上，蜜蜂数量翻倍与熊蜂数量下降14%相关。

sentences.en: Competition was fiercer at higher temperatures, which suggests climate change could make the problem worse.
sentences.zh: 温度越高竞争越激烈，这表明气候变化可能使问题恶化。

sentences.en: The number of registered beekeepers in the UK has risen from about 19,000 in 2010 to 47,000.
sentences.zh: 英国注册养蜂人数量已从2010年的约1.9万人增至4.7万人。

sentences.en: The authors stress that they are not discouraging beekeeping, but argue that hive numbers need careful management, particularly in cities.
sentences.zh: 作者强调，他们并非劝阻养蜂，而是认为蜂箱数量需要谨慎管理，尤其是在城市。

news.title: Heatwaves killed tens of thousands in Europe this summer
news.titleZh: 今夏热浪在欧洲造成数万人死亡

sentences.en: A new study estimates that this summer's heatwaves in Europe caused around 50,000 deaths.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究估计，今年夏天欧洲的热浪造成了约5万人死亡。

sentences.en: Researchers concluded that about two-thirds of those deaths would not have happened without climate change.
sentences.zh: 研究人员得出结论：如果没有气候变化，其中约三分之二的死亡本不会发生。

sentences.en: The analysis covered 854 European cities but did not include rural areas.
sentences.zh: 该分析覆盖了欧洲854座城市，但不包括农村地区。

sentences.en: That means the real number of deaths is likely to be even higher.
sentences.zh: 这意味着实际死亡人数可能更高。

sentences.en: Older people and those with heart or lung conditions are especially vulnerable during extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 在极端高温期间，老年人和患有心肺疾病的人尤其脆弱。

sentences.en: Health experts say many of these deaths could be prevented with better early warnings and cooler public spaces.
sentences.zh: 卫生专家表示，通过更好的预警和更凉爽的公共空间，许多死亡本可以避免。

news.title: Perseverance becomes the farthest-travelling vehicle on another world
news.titleZh: “毅力号”成为在地外星球行驶最远的车辆

sentences.en: NASA's Perseverance rover has set a new record for the longest distance driven on another planet.
sentences.zh: NASA的“毅力号”火星车创下了在其他行星上行驶距离最长的新纪录。

sentences.en: On 11 October, a drive of just over 91 metres took its total to about 45.2 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 10月11日，一次91米多的行驶使它的总里程达到约45.2公里。

sentences.en: The previous record had been held by the Opportunity rover, which covered 45.16 kilometres over a fourteen-year mission.
sentences.zh: 此前的纪录由“机遇号”保持，它在14年的任务中行驶了45.16公里。

sentences.en: Perseverance, which landed in Jezero Crater in 2021, beat that in under five years.
sentences.zh: 2021年降落在耶泽罗陨石坑的“毅力号”用不到五年就打破了这一纪录。

sentences.en: Its speed is largely thanks to AutoNav, a self-driving system that uses a dedicated computer to spot obstacles and plan routes.
sentences.zh: 它的速度主要归功于AutoNav自动驾驶系统，该系统用专门的计算机识别障碍并规划路线。

sentences.en: The rover is currently exploring rocks that are thought to be around four billion years old.
sentences.zh: 这辆火星车目前正在探索据信约有40亿年历史的岩石。

sentences.en: Scientists hope these rocks will reveal whether Mars once had conditions suitable for life.
sentences.zh: 科学家希望这些岩石能揭示火星过去是否具备适合生命的条件。
